plainText:
Jennifer Losi is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Losi is an American voice actress, born on February 10. Losi joined the series, voicing in Pokémon Masters EX. She joined the during , where she voiced Oleana.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Oleana

===Video games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Komainu (White), Yosuzume (In/Spectre)
Terano Totobami (Kakegurui)
Customer, Female Students (Mob Psycho 100)
Tamara (Sirius the Jaeger)
Rinko Kojiro (Sword Art Online)
Konatsu, Smoke (Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun)
Ganyu (Genshin Impact)
